Definition
1. Definition 5.1\group ch05-viscosity-solutions Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0102 A function $u\in C(\Omega )$ is a viscosity supersolution of $Lu=f$ if every $\varphi \in C^2(\Omega )$ touching $u$ from below at $x_0\in \Omega $ satisfies $L\varphi (x_0)\leq f(x_0)$. It is a viscosity subsolution if every such test touching from above satisfies $L\varphi (x_0)\geq f(x_0)$. A viscosity solution has both properties.
